name: Nebraska
standard: Revised Section 508 (as modified) + 28 CFR 35 Subpart H (WCAG 2.1 AA) for web and mobile

laws.summary: Requires a technology access clause, developed by the Commission for the Blind, NITC and the CIO, in every state agency contract for automated information systems, requiring equivalent visual and nonvisual access.

laws.cite: 28 CFR Part 35, Subpart H (ADA Title II web & mobile rule, 2024; dates extended by IFR 2026-07663)
laws.summary: Federal floor: state and local government web content and mobile apps must conform to WCAG 2.1 AA; the April 2026 IFR moved compliance to 2027-04-26 (pop. 50,000+) and 2028-04-26 (smaller entities and special districts).

policy_docs.title: NITC 2-201 (superseded; technology access clause moved to DAS)

applies_to: State agencies: ICT procured, developed, maintained or used; public safety systems exempt from 508 portion.

deadlines.what: ADA Title II rule: state government and local governments with population 50,000+ must conform web content and mobile apps to WCAG 2.1 AA (extended from 2026-04-24 by DOJ IFR effective 2026-04-20)
ADA Title II rule: local governments under 50,000 and special district governments (extended from 2027-04-26)

requires: Conform ICT to Revised 508 Standards with Nebraska modifications (legacy ICT cutoff 2020-11-14)
Web and mobile conform to 28 CFR 35 Subpart H
mobile: explicit — NITC 2-101(3)(b) adopts 28 CFR 35 Subpart H 'Web and Mobile Accessibility'.
procurement: Statutory technology access clause required in all state contracts for automated information systems; current clause posted by DAS Materiel Purchasing.
enforcement: No state penalty found; OCIO Digital Accessibility team support (OCIO.DigitalAccessibility@nebraska.gov); ADA Title II complaints.
notes: DAS vendor-info page with the current clause (das.nebraska.gov/materiel/purchase_bureau/vendor-info.html) was not opened. No accessibility statement or coordinator mandate found at state level.
